title: Data Engineer
description:
Headquarters: United States - Remote

Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@tebra.com (http://tebra.com/), @patientpop.com (http://patientpop.com/), or @kareo.com (http://kareo.com/)) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.

About the Role

As a Data Engineer focused on AI/ML, you’ll build, maintain, and optimize the data infrastructure that powers Tebra’s intelligent features. You’ll partner closely with Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, and Software Engineers to transform complex healthcare data into high-quality datasets and real-time features that enable machine learning models.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll contribute to scalable data pipelines, improve data quality, and help ensure our AI systems are powered by reliable, performant, and well-governed data. You’ll work on modern data platforms and gain experience building solutions that support both model training and production inference.

Your Area of Focus

• Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines for feature extraction, training data generation, and model monitoring.

• Develop and enhance data systems that support analytics and machine learning workloads, including data lakehouse and feature store technologies.

• Monitor production data pipelines, identify data quality issues or pipeline failures, and implement improvements to ensure reliability and freshness.

• Participate in engineering design discussions and contribute to technical decisions around data architecture and pipeline implementation.

• Build reusable data engineering components, including automated data quality checks, schema validation, and testing frameworks.

• Translate business requirements into scalable data solutions that enable analytics and machine learning use cases.

• Optimize SQL queries, Spark workloads, and data processing pipelines to improve performance and scalability.

• Collaborate with ML Engineers and cross-functional partners to support MLOps best practices, including data versioning, lineage, and reproducibility.

• Break down technical work into manageable tasks and deliver high-quality solutions within an agile team.

Your Professional Qualifications

• 3+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.

• 2+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining production data pipelines supporting analytics, reporting, or machine learning workloads.

• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL with experience developing production-quality data pipelines.

• Experience with modern data processing technologies such as Spark, Airflow, Kafka, or similar distributed data platforms.

• Experience working with cloud-based data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Delta Lake, or equivalent lakehouse technologies.

• Understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and data governance best practices.

• Familiarity with machine learning data workflows, including training datasets, feature engineering, and data quality concepts.

• Experience deploying and supporting production data pipelines with monitoring, testing, and CI/CD practices.

• Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and product teams.

• Excellent communication skills and a desire to continuously learn new technologies and engineering practices.

#LI-SS1 #LI-Remote

We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with competitive and fair compensation. For this position, this range reflects our Zone 1 (National Average) pay band. Your specific compensation is thoughtfully determined by your experience, qualifications, the specific requirements of the role, and your Geo Zone. Our geo-zone system ensures your pay is competitive for your location, recognizing varying costs of labor across regions.

Our four geo zones are designed to reflect this:
Zone 1: National Average
Zone 2: Moderately Higher Cost Regions
Zone 3: High-Cost Regions
Zone 4: Lower-Cost Regions

Beyond base compensation, Tebra offers eligible employees the opportunity for variable pay and a robust benefits package, reflecting our commitment to your overall well-being. In compliance with California pay transparency laws, the specific compensation range applicable to your Geo Zone will be shared during your initial talent screen.

Zone 1 (National Average)

$128,000—$145,200 USD

About Tebra

Tebra is the only all-in-one EHR+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing — so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout — helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more at www.tebra.com (http://www.tebra.com/).

Our Values

Start with the Customer

We get to know our customers - and their patients - and look at the world through their lens.

Keep It Simple

Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone.

Stay Entrepreneurial

We reject the status quo and solve problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action.

Better Together

We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together.

Celebrate Success

Life is short and joy is underrated. We take time to have fun and celebrate success.

Perks & Benefits

United States: In addition to our healthcare benefits, we also offer amazing perks! Need work from home basics? We offer a discount through Dell! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for a great workout, or TelusEmployee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences.

Costa Rica: To assist with all of life’s needs, Tebra also offers a wellness and childcare subsidy and a University/Education discount! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for access to health and fitness apps, or Telus Employee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences.

Compliance & Privacy Disclosures

NOTE: Tebra is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

California residents who apply or are recruited for a job with us: please carefully review our California-specific Privacy Notice under the California Consumer Protection Act here: https://www.tebra.com/privacy-policy/california-supplemental-notice/

If you would like to report a fraudulent Tebra job posting, please contact us at talentacquisition@tebra.com and consider reporting your experience to the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center or the Better Business Bureau to help keep others safe online, too.

As part of our commitment to a fair and efficient hiring process, Tebra utilizes BrightHire, an interview intelligence platform, for our phone and video screenings. This technology records and transcribes interviews to help us ensure consistency, reduce bias, and make more informed hiring decisions. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that your interview may be recorded.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/tebra-data-engineer

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About seQura

seQura provides innovative, flexible and easy-to-use payment technologies that help merchants acquire, convert and retain more customers.

We make a difference in sales performance by tailoring our solutions to different sectors, to address their unique pain points and deliver superior results in Retail, Education, Eyewear, Repairs and Travel.
We also empower smart shopping to consumers who seek more value, convenience, and flexibility in their shopping, with new payment experiences that allow them to save, access interest-free credit, or pay in small, comfortable instalments of up to 24 months.

Born in Barcelona, seQura is a privately-owned fintech, currently expanding throughout southern Europe and Latin America, growing above 50% CAGR and approaching 100 million in Annual Recurring Revenue.
Over 5000 businesses, almost 2 million shoppers, and almost 400 employees continue to rate us as one of the most loved and trusted fintechs out there, with an NPS of 87%, a Trustpilot rating of 4.7/5, and a Glassdoor rating of 4.7/5.

About the role 🤓

We have an exciting opening for a Senior Software Engineer who is able to see the big picture and balance the search for software quality with a pragmatic approach to help us scale the company. If you're a proactive, creative, and hands-on person who wants to help improve SeQura (https://himalayas.app/companies/sequra)'s product, having ownership and exposure to work hand in hand with seasoned professionals in a collaborative environment, this is the perfect place for you.

We have different projects to carry out our amazing product’s development, you’ll have the possibility to join us to help us grow by contributing to technical and architectural decisions and even creating new teams.

Requirements

What challenges you'll be solving 🚀

• Be passionate in the pursuit of writing simple, clean, and efficient code.

• Be proactive, accountable, analytical, and pragmatic.

• Contribute with close attention to detail/product ownership.

• Work as a strong team player and communicator.

• Arrive with motivation to learn and grow.

• Be passionate about driving change and efficiency with partners from different disciplines.

What we offer 😎

We have a strong and sustainable foundation, where we provide a secure and reliable workplace. You have the freedom and trust to make the best contribution possible.

One of our most valued strengths by our employees is our fellowship and supportive culture, which fosters a sense of belonging by working closely with our values. With us, you will have challenging projects to work on and push your skills and knowledge.

In addition, we are very proud of the unique office we have, which offers a comfortable and inspiring environment to work in with everything you need.

• 23 vacation days + 2 days of free disposal per year.

• Flexible compensation plan for transportation, restaurants, and kindergarten with Cobee.

• Health insurance discounts with Sanitas and DKV.

• Flexible working hours.

• A personal budget for professional development.

• Office workshops and meet-ups to encourage community participation and career growth.

• Hybrid or remote work (up to 2 hours difference from GMT+2).

Moreover, we have a Wellness Programthat embraces a holistic approach by covering 6 areas (occupational, physical, financial, emotional, social, and environmental consciousness). Each area will include a variety of activities, and you'll be able to choose from 34 different activities that best meet your needs to configure a plan that best works for you.

What you’ll need 🤝

• 7+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer.

• Experience in the full-stack development, deployment, and maintenance of web-based technology applications with Ruby on Rails or the ability and interest in working with it (JavaScript, Elixir, Kotlin, Java, and Python experience is also very valued).

• Solid knowledge of OOP, clean coding, TDD, and agile.

• English proficiency.

Which are the next steps? 🙌

• Interview with People Team

• Technical take-home assessment (async)

• Live Peer review of the assessment

• Meet the team

We kindly ask that you submit your CV in English, as it is the official language of our community.

We promote equal opportunity to all, regardless of age, color, gender identity, medical condition, physical or mental disability, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. We have an inclusive environment, and respect is above all.

Do you want to be part of the change? Join us!👇

seQura provides innovative, flexible and easy-to-use payment technologies that help merchants acquire, convert and retain more customers.

We make a difference in sales performance by tailoring our solutions to different sectors, to address their unique pain points and deliver superior results in Retail, Education, Eyewear, Repairs and Travel.
We also empower smart shopping to consumers who seek more value, convenience, and flexibility in their shopping, with new payment experiences that allow them to save, access interest-free credit, or pay in small, comfortable instalments of up to 24 months.

Born in Barcelona, seQura is a privately-owned fintech, currently expanding throughout southern Europe and Latin America, growing above 50% CAGR and approaching 100 million in Annual Recurring Revenue.
Over 5000 businesses, almost 2 million shoppers, and almost 400 employees continue to rate us as one of the most loved and trusted fintechs out there, with an NPS of 87%, a Trustpilot rating of 4.7/5, and a Glassdoor rating of 4.7/5.

About the role 🤓

We have an exciting opening for a Senior Software Engineer who is able to see the big picture and balance the search for software quality with a pragmatic approach to help us scale the company. If you're a proactive, creative, and hands-on person who wants to help improve SeQura (https://himalayas.app/companies/sequra)'s product, having ownership and exposure to work hand in hand with seasoned professionals in a collaborative environment, this is the perfect place for you.

We have different projects to carry out our amazing product’s development, you’ll have the possibility to join us to help us grow by contributing to technical and architectural decisions and even creating new teams.

Requirements

What challenges you'll be solving 🚀

• Be passionate in the pursuit of writing simple, clean, and efficient code.

• Be proactive, accountable, analytical, and pragmatic.

• Contribute with close attention to detail/product ownership.

• Work as a strong team player and communicator.

• Arrive with motivation to learn and grow.

• Be passionate about driving change and efficiency with partners from different disciplines.

What we offer 😎

We have a strong and sustainable foundation, where we provide a secure and reliable workplace. You have the freedom and trust to make the best contribution possible.

One of our most valued strengths by our employees is our fellowship and supportive culture, which fosters a sense of belonging by working closely with our values. With us, you will have challenging projects to work on and push your skills and knowledge.

In addition, we are very proud of the unique office we have, which offers a comfortable and inspiring environment to work in with everything you need.

• 23 vacation days + 2 days of free disposal per year.

• Flexible compensation plan for transportation, restaurants, and kindergarten with Cobee.

• Health insurance discounts with Sanitas and DKV.

• Flexible working hours.

• A personal budget for professional development.

• Office workshops and meet-ups to encourage community participation and career growth.

• Hybrid or remote work (up to 2 hours difference from GMT+2).

Moreover, we have a Wellness Programthat embraces a holistic approach by covering 6 areas (occupational, physical, financial, emotional, social, and environmental consciousness). Each area will include a variety of activities, and you'll be able to choose from 34 different activities that best meet your needs to configure a plan that best works for you.

What you’ll need 🤝

• 7+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer.

• Experience in the full-stack development, deployment, and maintenance of web-based technology applications with Ruby on Rails or the ability and interest in working with it (JavaScript, Elixir, Kotlin, Java, and Python experience is also very valued).

• Solid knowledge of OOP, clean coding, TDD, and agile.

• English proficiency.

Which are the next steps? 🙌

• Interview with People Team

• Technical take-home assessment (async)

• Live Peer review of the assessment

• Meet the team

We kindly ask that you submit your CV in English, as it is the official language of our community.

We promote equal opportunity to all, regardless of age, color, gender identity, medical condition, physical or mental disability, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. We have an inclusive environment, and respect is above all.

Do you want to be part of the change? Join us!👇

title: Staff Software Engineer (SRE)
description:
Phantom (https://phantom.com) is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom (https://jobicy.com/company/phantom) to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Phantom partners with many of the most trusted and influential names in finance like Hyperliquid, Stripe, Kalshi and Visa, to make the most popular and innovative financial products accessible to everyone.

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

Responsibilities

•
Kubernetes Ownership: Manage and scale Kubernetes clusters on AWS EKS, ensuring reliability, performance, and security.

•
Infrastructure Automation: Implement and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Pulumi) to automate infrastructure provisioning and management.

•
Performance Optimization: Monitor and optimize system performance, scalability, and resource utilization.

•
Blockchain Infrastructure: Configure and maintain crypto nodes across multiple blockchains to support our wallet’s operations.

•
Database Scaling: Optimize and scale database infrastructure to handle terabytes of blockchain data efficiently.

•
System Reliability: Continuously improve system uptime, monitoring, and observability using tools like Datadog and OpenTelemetry.

•
Collaboration: Work closely with backend and product teams to support feature development and system scaling.

Qualifications

•
8+ years in a SRE or Software Engineer role.

•
Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) in production environments.

•
Proficiency with AWS infrastructure and services (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM).

•
Solid experience with Docker and Infrastructure-as-Code tools like Terraform or Pulumi.

•
Monitoring and observability experience using tools like Datadog or OpenTelemetry.

Why Work with Us

We are a team of experienced builders in the blockchain and crypto industry. Our journey began from users seeking an easy, seamless path to accessing the crypto ecosystem. This passion fueled our exponential growth, allowing us to onboard over 20M+ active users in just over three years; with our user base growing weekly. Our dedication to a secure and seamless user experience has made us the leading wallet on Solana as well as our multi-chain approach enhances our platform's versatility, meeting the needs of a diverse and growing user base. By staying at the forefront of technology and user expectations, we continue to innovate and set industry standards on self-custodial crypto wallets.

There has never been a better time to work in crypto to help shape the future of innovation with a focus around the wallet experience!

•
First impressions matter: Wallets are responsible for a users first impression with crypto and onboarding new users into crypto. By ensuring that a user has a great first-time experience with crypto, we can help supercharge the growth of the entire ecosystem.

•
Make crypto easier to navigate: There is no easy way for a user to discover and navigate all that crypto has to offer. Wallets have a unique opportunity to help users not only onboard to crypto but also stay retained by exploring new things to do.

•
We live in a multi-chain world: We currently support Solana, Ethereum, Polygon and Bitcoin with more networks to come in the new future. We are focused on creating a unified, multi-chain crypto experience for users.

Benefits

•
Competitive salary and equity

•
You will be eligible to participate in the Company's performance bonus program

•
Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision) — 100% covered

•
Stipend for your ideal remote set-up

•
Flexible hours and a supportive remote environment

•
Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

•
401(k) retirement plan

•
Monthly wellness benefit

•
Weekly meal benefit

•
Global off-sites

The target base salary for this role will range between $200,000 to $250,000 with the addition of equity and benefits. This is determined by a few factors including your skillset, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews and market factors (such as location) at the point in time of offer.

If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Identity Platform
description:
Headquarters: United States (Remote)

About Prove

As the world moves to a mobile-first economy, businesses need to modernize how they acquire, engage with and enable consumers. Prove’s phone-centric identity tokenization and passive cryptographic authentication solutions reduce friction, enhance security and privacy across all digital channels, and accelerate revenues while reducing operating expenses and fraud losses. Over 1,000 enterprise customers use Prove’s platform to process 20 billion customer requests annually across industries, including banking, lending, healthcare, gaming, crypto, e-commerce, marketplaces, and payments. For the latest updates from Prove, follow us on LinkedIn. (https://www.linkedin.com/company/proveidentity/)

Prove is driving the future of digital identity. We are looking for Provers who know how to make an impact. We’re talking self-starting professionals who thrive in a fast-paced environment, process information quickly, and make intelligent decisions. The work is challenging and requires not only smart but natural curiosity and tenacity. Teamwork is also important to us – we work together and play together.

Prove has big plans, and we’re excited about the future. If this sounds like the place for you – come join our team!

Title: Senior Software Engineer

Department: Engineering

Reports To: Manager, Engineering

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: US Remote

Job Summary

As a Senior Software Engineer at Prove, you will play a critical role in building, maintaining, and scaling the technology that powers the next generation of identity verification. Whether working on consumer and business identity services or developing low-level phone intelligence data signals, you will design and implement robust, high-performance solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex technical challenges, improve system architecture, and contribute to the mission-critical infrastructure that helps institutions solve fraud and verify digital identity worldwide.

Team Focus Areas

We are currently hiring for two engineering teams, each solving unique challenges in the identity space:

• Data Engineering Team: Join our team to design and build the fault-tolerant, scalable platforms powering our core identity services (Verified Users, Prefill, and KYB/KYC). You’ll work hands-on with senior engineers and product leaders to tackle complex, high-scale architectural challenges and directly influence our identity verification roadmap.

• Phone Number Intelligence: Our team focuses on phone intelligence and generating low-level data signals used by various internal services. This work is foundational to our fraud detection capabilities, providing specialized knowledge of mobile carrier data and fraud patterns. We are currently migrating data and migrating to an event-driven architecture, offering an exciting opportunity for someone to shape our infrastructure.

Responsibilities

• Engineering Excellence: Write high-quality, maintainable code, develop detailed technical documentation, and champion strong engineering principles within the team.

• System Development: Design and develop microservices within a cloud-native, distributed architecture.

• Problem Solving: Analyze, debug, and resolve production issues. Proactively engage in technical design discussions, including writing and reviewing RFCs for new solutions.

• Technical Leadership: Mentor team members, participate in code reviews, and drive technical decisions. Own end-to-end features—from initial design and RFC creation to implementation and maintenance.

• Collaborative development: Participate in the "Owner/Helper" project model; contribute as a lead owner for major milestones and actively support team members on their own initiatives.

Your First Three Months

30 Days (Onboarding): Gain a high-level understanding of our architecture, team goals, and existing services. Make your first code contributions by resolving bugs or tackling small tasks within the codebase.

60 Days (Contribution): Integrate into the design process by reviewing RFCs and providing technical feedback. Contribute significantly as an active team member to one of our milestones.

90 Days (Ownership): Develop a deep grasp of our product and migration strategies. Take ownership of a minor or major milestone, or lead the drafting of an RFC for a new initiative.

Qualifications

• Software Development: 6+ years of professional software development experience, with a deep understanding of object-oriented programming (Java highly preferred).

• System Design: Experience designing event-driven, robust, and scalable solutions for complex technical problems.

• Cloud Proficiency: Hands-on experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

• Data & Database Expertise: Proficiency in SQL (Oracle) and NoSQL (DynamoDB) with strong knowledge of design principles for both.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• Full-Stack Development: Experience with TypeScript and React.

• CI/CD & Testing: Ability to build automated test frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.

• Streaming Technologies: Practical experience with Kafka and Flink.

• Modern Tech: Familiarity with AI and machine learning integrations.

• Technical Leadership: Proven ability to influence team direction and long-term architectural decisions.

This position description should not be considered the final description of the position. The position description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the positions. It should be assumed that we would, to some extent, structure responsibilities in accordance with the successful candidate’s capabilities and changing business conditions. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor.

The anticipated salary range for this role is

Metro 2: 190,000 - 210,000

Metro 3: 170,000 - 190,000

Plus variable commission / company bonus. Offered salary will be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, geo-location and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Prove follows a market driven compensation philosophy based on geographic location and respective market rates. Job offers will be aligned to location. Please speak with your recruiter if you have questions. Prove defines:

• Metro 2 - NYC metro area, Seattle metro area, Los Angeles metro area, and the Miami metro area.

• Metro 3 - all other cities across the domestic United States, with the exception of the San Francisco Bay Area.

Benefits & Perks for FTE Provers:

• Competitive salaries & Bonus Plan (for eligible roles) and Equity Plan

• Modern Health for financial, mental, and physical wellness

• 401(k) Retirement Plan & Match (US Offices) and Local Country Pension (International Offices)

• Unlimited Vacation and Flexible hours

• Comprehensive medical benefits for you and your family ️

• Emotional & Physical Wellness – Access to wellness services (EAP & Prove Well-Being Reimbursement)

• Bottomless snacks & beverages for certain office locations

• Daily GrubHub stipend for lunch if coming into the office (US Offices)

• A great place to work and connect with other talented Provers like yourself!

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Prove we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Equal Opportunity Employment:

Prove is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people regardless of race, color, religion, gender or sexual orientation, age, marital status, national origin, citizenship status, disability, veteran status or other personal characteristics

Privacy & Data Protection:

When you are applying for a job at Prove, we collect and use your personal information in the job application process. To understand more about how Prove uses your personal information, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy (https://www.prove.com/legal/recruitment-privacy-notice) on our website.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/prove-senior-software-engineer-identity-platform

We’re seeking a full-time, remote Market Research Data Analyst for our company.

We’re fully distributed, with ~60 team members spanning America and Europe, all committed to advancing ecommerce UX.

What You’ll Do

As our Market Research Data Analyst, you’ll own quantitative survey studies from initial research and questionnaire design through fieldwork, analysis, and publication.

Our Quant Insights team conducts recurring studies (https://baymard.com/blog/quantitative-insights-launch) examining how consumers research, evaluate, and purchase products and services online across different industries and focused topics. A typical study takes approximately three months from beginning to end. Once one study is completed, you’ll begin the research cycle again in another industry or topic area.

This means the role combines variety in subject matter with consistency in research methodology. You might spend one study investigating how consumers shop for electronics and the next examining how they book flights, while following a similar end-to-end research process each time. However, a significant part of this role involves repeatedly executing and improving a structured research process.

At the same time, the process itself is not fixed.

Our Quant Insights team is relatively new, and our research program continues to evolve. Team members are encouraged to challenge existing approaches, experiment with better methods, improve our tooling and workflows, and propose changes to how studies are designed or executed.

If you identify a better way to design a questionnaire, analyze our data, automate part of the workflow, structure a study, or even rethink part of our research process, we want you to make the case for it and help us improve it.

Your responsibilities will include:

Research & Survey Design

•
Conducting desk research to understand an industry, its consumers, and the ecommerce experiences we want to investigate.

•
Translating research objectives into clear, testable research questions.

•
Designing questionnaires, including question wording, response scales, survey structure, branching, and screening criteria.

•
Identifying appropriate respondent audiences, quotas, and sample requirements.

•
Reviewing pilot results and refining questionnaires before full fielding.

•
Considering potential sources of survey bias, measurement error, and data-quality issues throughout the research process.

Survey & Fieldwork Execution

•
Programming and QA’ing surveys (we use Alchemer), including logic, quotas, branching, and redirects.

•
Coordinating with sample providers on feasibility, targeting, and setup (we use PureSpectrum).

•
Monitoring soft launches and active fieldwork.

•
Evaluating incoming responses for data-quality issues and determining appropriate cleaning or exclusion criteria.

•
Troubleshooting issues independently.

Data Analysis & Synthesis

•
Cleaning, structuring, and analyzing survey datasets.

•
Conducting descriptive and comparative analyses across questions and respondent segments.

•
Exploring relationships and meaningful differences within the data while avoiding overinterpretation of results.

•
Identifying the most meaningful findings from large survey datasets rather than simply reporting every result.

•
Synthesizing findings across multiple questions to develop broader insights into consumer behavior.

•
Creating charts and writing analysis takeaways that communicate findings clearly.

•
Translating quantitative findings into concise, evidence-based insights relevant to ecommerce UX professionals and decision-makers.

Your role may gradually expand to include new or more complex studies, program management, or strategic initiatives, depending on your interests and Baymard’s needs.

Your Daily Tasks

While your exact workload will vary depending on where your current study is in its lifecycle, most of your time will involve activities such as:

•
Researching consumer behavior within an industry.

•
Designing and refining survey questions.

•
Programming and QA’ing surveys.

•
Reviewing pilot data and determining what should change before launch.

•
Coordinating sampling and monitoring fieldwork.

•
Cleaning and preparing survey datasets.

•
Analyzing overall results and meaningful respondent segments.

•
Investigating interesting or unexpected patterns in the data.

•
Determining which findings are meaningful enough to publish.

•
Creating charts and synthesizing findings into clearly written research insights.

The remainder of your time may involve team discussions, methodology development, documentation, process improvements, tooling, cross-functional collaboration, or experimentation with new approaches.

Who You Are

We’re looking for someone who:

•
Enjoys both the design and analytical sides of quantitative research.

•
Likes taking ownership of a research project from an initial question through final findings.

•
Enjoys working with structured processes and becoming better and more efficient at executing them over time, while offering ideas and initiative to improve and streamline them as needed.

•
Is naturally detail-oriented and methodical in their work.

•
Is comfortable troubleshooting and resolving field issues independently, but knows when to escalate larger problems for discussion or review

•
Communicates clearly and asks precise questions when clarifying requirements.

•
Enjoys cross-functional work and being involved in the early stages of a program.

What You’ll Need

We’re looking for the following qualifications for this role:

•
2–3+ years of professional experience in quantitative research, market research, survey research, consumer insights, or a closely related field.

•
Hands-on experience designing questionnaires and conducting online survey research.

•
Experience analyzing survey datasets and synthesizing quantitative findings into meaningful conclusions.

•
A solid understanding of survey design fundamentals, including question wording, response scales, questionnaire structure, screening, and common sources of bias.

•
Experience working with survey platforms such as Alchemer, Qualtrics, SurveyMonkey, or similar.

•
Experience using Excel, Google Sheets, statistical software, or other analytical tools to explore and analyze quantitative data.

•
Comfort interpreting percentages, distributions, cross-tabulations, and differences between respondent groups.

•
Ability to communicate findings clearly, in writing, to audiences who may not have a research background.

•
Strong communication skills and a disciplined, detail-oriented working style.

You’ll be part of our growing Quant Insights team and will work closely with the Research, Product, Engineering, and Commercial Operations teams, making collaboration essential.

title: Strategy and Analytics Business Partner
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Strategy & Analytics Internal Systems and SDC team aspires to supercharge the Internal Systems and SDC organization with analytics and insights. The Internal Systems and SDC org creates the engineering infrastructure and runs the internal operations that enables Stripe to succeed. We deliver data-driven insights that inform business decisions, drive measurable operational improvements, and guide strategy. We are not just data analysts, we are a mix of strategic business partners, deeply strategic and/or technical operational executors. We ensure timely, reliable, high-quality data for not just Internal Systems and SDC, but for stakeholders across Stripe.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll be the go-to expert for your business area. You’ll partner directly with leaders within the SDC and be their go-to for all things data, insights, and strategy. You’ll be hands-on and responsible for delivering critical insights, ensuring data driven decision making is at the core of what we do. You’ll partner with leadership to drive business strategy, planning, goal-setting and performance tracking. You may also scope and lead mission critical projects and execute on strategic initiatives.

Responsibilities

• Metrics & Insights: Wrangle large, highly complex datasets using SQL into actionable insights and become the data expert for your business area. Develop metrics and large-scale dashboards to track the health of our user-facing and internal teams. Perform analyses (using SQL & other analytical tools/languages), identify trends, conduct research, build models, all to deliver objective, critical insights that can inform leadership of opportunities, risks, and strategic priorities.

• Communicate with executives: Create narratives and documents that tell the story of your business area to influence senior Operations leadership and Stripe executive team decision making. Own executive-facing weekly, monthly or quarterly reporting.

• Stakeholder management: Influence and drive cross-functional change by partnering with stakeholders across a wide internal network of globally distributed teams, including Ops, Finance, Data Science, Product/Engineering, and more

• Drive operational excellence: Design, optimize and drive operational reviews and rhythm of the business. Guide the planning and goal-setting process for your business area, as well as progress checks throughout the year. Bring and consistently apply a ROI lens to all operational decisions, so we can make better-informed trade-offs

• Conduct internal knowledge sharing sessions to strengthen the team

Who you are

You’re passionate about solving business problems and making a direct impact on business. You thrive in environments with many moving parts and quickly pick up new domain knowledge and technologies (e.g. AI). We’re seeking someone with excellent communication and advanced SQL/analytics abilities. Strong background in Accounting/Finance or prior AI experience is highly preferred, though these can also be developed on the job.

Minimum requirements

• Bachelor's degree in STEM major (i.e. Computer Science, Math, Stat, Engineering, etc.) and 4+ years of prior working experience in data analysis fields

• Strong analytical ability, proficiency with SQL (minimum of 3 years advanced SQL) and strong understanding of data relationships

• Experience working with extremely large datasets

• Experience with AI tools (Claude Code, etc.) and have demonstrated measurable impact from AI in your role or in others’ around you.

• Outstanding communication, presentation skills & stakeholder management skills

• Experience working in or with Financial Services, Accounting, GTM/Sales, Operations

• Expertise working cross-functionally and with globally distributed teams to drive business and operational goals using data

• Ability to connect the big picture to minute details, toggling between them to set and operationalize strategy

Preferred qualifications

• Experience working in fast-paced environments (e.g. high-growth fintech/tech company, management consulting)

• Experience working with Product Manager and Engineering teams

• Experience with visualization tools

URL: https://paragonplanners.com/employment/

Part-Time Remote Database & CRM Specialist (Training Provided)

Paragon Planners | Remote, U.S. | $20–$23 per hour

About Paragon Planners

At Paragon Planners, we provide administrative and operational support to professionals in the financial services industry. We're a fully remote team that values accuracy, dependability, communication, and people who take pride in doing great work.

We're looking for a Database & CRM Specialist to join our team and help keep the information behind our operations organized, accurate, and running smoothly.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with spreadsheets, learning new systems, solving problems, and digging into the details. You'll receive training on our processes and work closely with our Database & IT Director as you grow into the role.

What You'll Be Doing

•
Organizing, cleaning, and maintaining Excel spreadsheets and databases

•
Identifying duplicate records, formatting issues, and data inconsistencies

•
Preparing, reviewing, and validating information for CRM uploads

•
Assisting with territory mapping, travel zones, and geographic data organization

•
Helping analyze advisor rankings, territory information, and other operational data

•
Generating CRM reports and maintaining accurate records

•
Tracking projects, deadlines, and assigned tasks

•
Maintaining accurate billing-related documentation

•
Protecting confidential information and ensuring data integrity

•
Learning new systems and supporting additional database projects as needed

What We're Looking For

•
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy

•
Experience working with Microsoft Excel and organizing data

•
Comfort learning new software and navigating multiple applications

•
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills

•
Ability to manage assignments independently while communicating progress and asking questions when needed

•
Dependability, professionalism, and good time management

•
Experience with Microsoft Office, Google Docs/Sheets, and Outlook

•
High school diploma or GED and at least one year of related experience or training; two or more years preferred

Experience with CRM systems, database maintenance, or data analysis is helpful, but you do not need to know our specific systems. We're happy to train the right person!

Position Details

•
Fully remote, part-time opportunity

•
Starting pay: $20–$23 per hour, depending on experience and location

•
Training provided

•
Reports to the Database & IT Director

•
Requires a reliable internet connection, a quiet home workspace, and a compatible Windows computer

Eligible Hiring States

We are currently only hiring in the following states:

AL, AZ, FL, GA, ID, KY, LA, MI, MO, NC, OH, OR, SC, TN, TX, UT, and WY.

As Paragon Planners is not currently able to employ individuals in every state, continued employment following a relocation depends on your new location and cannot be guaranteed.

If you enjoy working with data, have strong organizational skills, and are excited about learning new systems, we'd love to hear from you!

Please submit your resume and a cover letter explaining your interest in the position, your experience with spreadsheets or database systems, and how your skills would help you succeed in this role.

Click Here To Apply! (https://paragonplanners.com/employment/)

Application Timeline: We'll begin contacting selected applicants regarding next steps by October 23, 2026.

Paragon Planners is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/paragon-planners-part-time-remote-database-crm-specialist

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Deep Digital are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Data Engineer with a proven track record in successfully implementing, optimizing, and maintaining the data integration and historian systems.

The ideal candidate will possess in-depth knowledge of industrial processes, data historian best practices, and a strong ability to lead and mentor junior team members. This role involves advanced technical responsibilities and collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure the seamless operation of data integration and historian systems.

Responsibilities

• Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of data historian solutions.

• Lead efforts to integrate historian systems with various control systems and third-party applications.

• Conduct performance analysis and implement strategies for continuous improvement.

• Design and configure complex data tags to meet specific project requirements

• Develop custom interfaces and connectors to enhance data integration capabilities

• Develop and implement advanced security measures to protect historical data.

• Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations, taking a lead role in audits and assessments

• Investigate and resolve complex issues related to data collection, storage, and retrieval.

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers in the team

• Maintain comprehensive documentation for all configurations, installations, and troubleshooting procedures.

• Comply with Deep Digitals Quality Management System requirements i.e. perform your work according to your process documents, procedures and maintaining document information/completing department forms/records as required.

Job benefits:

• Remote working

• 22 days Annual leave

• Company pension

• Medical insurance

• Employee Assistance Program

• Income Protection

• Life Insurance

• Sports an Social Club

• Paid sick leave

• Bike to work scheme

• Professional development

Requirements

• Bachelors degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or related field

• Between 3 and 5 years of hands-on experience with design, implementation and leadership in projects, comprising of the following systems: AVEVA PI, AspenTech IP.21, AspenTech Inmation, Inductive Automation Ignition, PTC Kepware.

• In-depth knowledge of data integration and historian system architecture and components.

• Strong understanding of industrial processes and automation systems.

• Expertise with data contextualisation, visualisation and reporting platforms.

• Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell) for automation tasks.

• Previous experience in mentoring and leading a technical team

• Good communication skills

Highlights

If you are a talented Data Engineer looking to contribute to cutting-edge projects in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply.

With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Oportun’s flagship, AI-powered Savings product. Savings is an important driver of member growth and retention, giving this role significant influence over the future of our financial health platform and how we help members build stronger financial futures.

You’ll lead the ideation, development, launch, and scaling of new products and features while partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Legal, and Customer Support. This role reports to the Vice President & General Manager for Savings and Mobile. Candidates located in Central or Eastern time zones are strongly preferred to support team and stakeholder collaboration.

title: Video Editor
description:
Kalshi (https://jobicy.com/company/kalshi) is defining a new category

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history. Kalshi is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

• Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

• Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Building a new category is hard… like really hard. But it’s beautiful and deeply fulfilling (https://x.com/Kalshi/status/1853456453886980215). Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

We are looking for a Video Editor who is passionate about creating viral social media content, including TikTok and other user-generated content. We have a massive nationwide campaign coming up that will involve hundreds of videos being created. This role will be crucial to the success of the campaign.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Edit and produce high-quality, engaging social media videos, including UGC TikTok videos, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

• Collaborate with our creative and social teams to ideate, plan, and execute video content that will go viral.

• Transform raw footage into polished, short-form video content that’s optimized for social media.

• Stay up-to-date with social media video trends, techniques, and best practices to ensure content resonates with our audience.

• Ability to film or capture content is a plus—helping guide shoots or even capturing footage on occasion.

Who You Are:

You love making super high quality engaging videos and have made many viral videos yourself. You thrive in fast-paced environments and are obsessed with crafting content that engages and excites audiences.

Some basic requirements:

• Experience making videos that have gone viral.

• 2+ years of experience in video editing, specifically for social media platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

• Proven ability to create highly engaging and viral content.

• A creative mindset with a keen understanding of storytelling, pacing, and the latest video trends.

• Experience in editing short-form, fast-paced videos for social media audiences.

• Experience with sound editing, color correction, and motion graphics is a plus.

• Bonus: Experience in filming content or directing video shoots.

NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure:

Salary Range: $70,000 to $150,000 annually plus equity and benefits.

This salary range is based on the current available market data and represents the expected salary range for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and few titles, but a broad range of experience is represented within roles. Should you have compensation expectations that exceed these bands, we'd love to hear from you and would welcome you to reach out to discuss further.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Product Marketing Manager (TEMPORARY)
description:
Headquarters: United States - Remote

Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@tebra.com (http://tebra.com/), @patientpop.com (http://patientpop.com/), or @kareo.com (http://kareo.com/)) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.

About the Role

We’re looking for a candidate who is passionate about healthcare, and providing independent healthcare practitioners the best single solution for delivering high quality care to patients. If you nerd out on positioning and messaging, love diving deep into market research and competitive intelligence, and think any time spent talking to customers is time well spent, this is the job for you. This role serves as the nexus of knowledge for EHR and care delivery products for the private practice market.

Your Area of Focus

• Conduct market research and analysis to identify customer needs, preferences, and trends

• Develop product positioning, messaging, and value propositions that resonate with target audiences

• Partner with product management to ensure that our products and services are meeting customer needs and delivering value

• Collaborate with the sales team to develop sales enablement materials, including presentations, demos, and case studies

• Make complex concepts easy to understand

• Analyze and report on key metrics, including customer acquisition, engagement, and retention

• Stay up-to-date on industry trends and best practices related to product marketing and healthcare to identify trends and emerging opportunities.

• Deliver weekly, monthly and quarterly competitive intelligence that draws on internal and external data, research and analysis and uses the voice of our customer.

description:
Headquarters: Remote US

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: SDR Manager

Location: Remote US

Compensation Range: $58,500 base with on target earnings at $78,000 plus equity

What You'll Do:

Huntress is looking for a talented and passionate Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help fuel our continued growth. In this role, you will open doors for the Account Executive team by building relationships with managed service providers (MSPs) and managed security service providers (MSSPs), earning trust quickly, and turning early conversations into qualified meetings that move the pipeline forward. You are outcome-obsessed in how you work, with a clear eye on the right next step, the right partner fit, and the follow-through it takes to create real pipeline impact.

In the daily rhythm of prospecting into the MSP and MSSP space, you bring warrior spirit. You stay steady through rejection, keep your standards high, and come back sharper on the next call. You also give a sh*t about the people on the other end of the phone, leading with honesty, curiosity, and respect as you help prospective partners understand the value Huntress can deliver to their business and their customers.

Responsibilities:

• Establish rapport and trust with managed service provider (MSP) and managed security service provider (MSSP) prospects via phone, email, and LinkedIn to understand their business and their fit with Huntress.

• Set qualified meetings within our ideal customer profile by following best practices and standard processes.

• Generate and qualify net-new accounts and work inbound opportunities to create a pipeline for the Account Executive team.

• Use clear, value-driven messaging to build interest in Huntress and answer prospect questions with honesty, professionalism, and empathy.

• Research accounts, document prospecting activity, and qualification notes in CRM, and maintain strong data hygiene.

• Use AI tools with good judgment to support account research, call prep, and message drafting in your day-to-day work.

• Keep improving your cold calling, messaging, and pipeline management skills through training, feedback, and repetition.

What You Bring to the Team:

• 8+ months of experience in a quota-carrying outbound B2B SaaS sales role.

• Experience with outbound cold calling.

• Strong time management and the ability to prioritize competing tasks.

• Comfort working across CRM, prospecting tools, and multiple systems at the same time.

• Attention to detail when taking notes, setting meetings, and following the process.

• A coachable mindset and a genuine interest in continuing to grow your sales and cybersecurity knowledge.

• Curiosity about AI and the judgment to use it in practical ways that help you work faster and smarter in your day-to-day.

What We Offer:

• 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015

• Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays

• 12 weeks of paid parental leave

• Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans

• 401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution

• Life and Disability insurance plans

• Stock options for all full-time employees

• One-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office

• Annual allowance for education and professional development assistance

• $75 USD/month digital reimbursement

• Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth

title: Business Risk Officer
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. We work hard to create the easiest and safest banking* experience possible to simplify our customer’s financial lives whether they are entrepreneurs, business owners, or individuals.  Mercury has also obtained a provisional national bank charter and is currently taking proactive steps for final approval.

Role Overview:

We're looking for a Business Risk Officer to help scale the way Mercury builds products.  In this role you will report to our Head of Business Risk & Enablement and will partner with Product, Operations, Compliance and many other support and oversight teams to ensure that products and features are delivered “best-in-class” in a safe and sound manner.  Your success in this role will rely on subject matter expertise in one or more of Mercury’s core product offerings and associated risks. You will also be primarily responsible for the facilitation of non-financial risk management programs (see below).

Key Responsibilities:

• Identify any potential blind spots in processes and controls, and suggest commercial improvements/enhancements

• Facilitate pre-launch and new activity initiatives/reviews, tracking items to closure and escalating where/when necessary

• Facilitate execution of risk self assessments and similar exercises within the non-financial risk frameworks

• Event/incident, issues , and remediations management - ensuring that incidents and issues are recorded and managed through to remediation in line with any and all relevant frameworks in the company

• Develop and enhance iteratively KPIs/KRIs to be monitored by yourself, product/process owners, and other stakeholders in order to mitigate risk

• Coordinate interactions and responses between Product and Operations teams vs. other stakeholders for audits, exams and similar reviews (internal and external)

• Engage and partner deeply with stakeholders across the organization including Product, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, etc.

• Help design / provide feedback on certain enterprise/firm-wide trainings and deliver trainings as needed

Qualifications:

• Have at least 5 - 7+ years of experience in a banking, fintech, or other financial services firms in a product/business, business risks and/or controls, operational risk, or other similar roles

• Track record of balancing risk, compliance, and customer experience in cross-functional settings

• Excellent communication skills to simplify complex business, reg and/or risk concepts into clear explanations and/or recommendations

• Familiarity with Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) practices and non-financial risk frameworks

• Curious, growth-oriented, and motivated to work on risk and controls at all lifecycle stages (new product launches, scaling, and legacy optimization)

• Bring a collaborative, problem-solving mindset to your work, have strong stakeholder management skills, and an ability to influence without direct authority

title: Account Executive - Technology
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within United States

At Mercury, building our customer base has been a wild and exciting adventure—and we’re just getting started. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a thoughtful, driven Account Executive to help more founders, finance leaders, and business owners discover and thrive with Mercury.

Over the past two years, we've significantly expanded our startup customer base and we’re continuing on that journey to support even more startups and teams on Mercury. In this role you’ll have the opportunity to work closely with founders and finance leaders helping them shape the future of their finance stack with Mercury at the center. You’ll uncover pain points tied to current operations, run point on complex evaluations with multiple-products, and simplify the migration process across their full-stack into Mercury.

As an Account Executive, you’ll work directly with founders, business owners, and finance teams to deeply understand their operational needs and guide them to the right financial tools. You’ll immerse yourself in their ecosystems and uncover pain points to help them build great businesses with Mercury.

Here are some things you'll do on the job:

• Run cold outbound-driven sales cycles to convert leads into long-term Mercury partners

• Go deep to uncover business cases and pain that aren't obvious on the surface

• Sell across multiple products in longer, more strategic cycles

• Multi-thread across stakeholders and build champions inside the account

• Build mutual action plans and drive deals forward on a shared timeline

• Influence requirements in Mercury's favor as accounts evaluate their options

• Orchestrate multiple stakeholders and moving pieces at once without dropping the thread

• Own and expand the relationship across the first 90 days of the customer journey

What we're looking for:

• 1+ year of closing experience, primarily cold outbound-driven, in SaaS, fintech, or similar

• Track record of converting cold leads into long-term partners, not just first meetings

• Comfortable running multi-product, strategic selling cycles rather than single-product transactional ones

• Skilled at building pain and urgency even when the account isn't presenting it themselves

• Experience multi-threading, building champions, and influencing requirements in a competitive process

Summary:
Toptal is an exclusive network of the top freelance software developers, designers, finance experts, product managers, and project managers in the world. Top companies hire Toptal freelancers for their most important projects.

We’re currently looking for a new member of our English Screening Team. In this hourly, remote engagement, you will serve as one of the first points of contact for applicants entering the Toptal network. Your ability to communicate clearly, assess candidates effectively, and create a positive experience will play a key role in maintaining Toptal’s high talent bar.

•
Provide notes and documentation after each interview

•

•
Collaborate with the team to ensure alignment on screening standards and processes

•
Contribute to continuous improvement of screening workflows and candidate experience

•
Represent Toptal as a first touchpoint, ensuring a strong and professional brand impression

•
Work in a fast-paced, fully remote environment with a focus on efficiency and quality

•
Handle multiple screenings per day while maintaining high evaluation standards

•
Work under an hourly engagement structure

•
Workload may vary, but you can generally expect up to 8 hours of work per day depending on team needs and your availability

•
Strong interpersonal and interviewing skills

•
Experience conducting interviews or candidate assessments is preferred

•
Comfortable handling video calls and engaging with global candidates

•
Highly organized with strong time management skills

•
Ability to work independently and manage workload effectively

•

Flexibility to cover key time zones (APAC, EU and US time zones)

Availability to support an hourly engagement model, with capacity to work up to 8 hours per day as needed

title: General Manager, Collibra Public Sector
description:
Headquarters: Remote, East Coast USA

Collibra is the Enterprise AI Control Plane. Built over eighteen years of meta-data and ontology engineering, Collibra governs context and control across any data storage system, AI model, and AI agent.  Collibra delivers clarity and context to AI leaders who need data certainty at the speed of AI. A 5x Forrester Wave Leader and 2x Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader, Collibra serves more than 700 customers, including 78 of the Fortune 500, and governs more than 2 billion assets.

Collibra Public Sector LLC is the purpose-built subsidiary that serves US federal government agencies and the Defense Industrial Base. Collibra Public Sector is a FOCI-mitigated entity with a DCSA facility clearance. Collibra Public Sector personnel service clients in some of the most demanding mission organizations. Collibra Public Sector products, people and partners are uniquely positioned to deliver software and services solutions to the US federal market.

Join Collibra Public Sector

Collibra is looking for a proven General Manager to create and execute the overall business strategy to achieve long-term profitable growth that outpaces competitors and peers. Responsibilities include recruiting and leading a high-performing team that integrates sales, consulting services, support, legal, operations, marketing, product management, and product delivery. The General Manager will set the direction for the subsidiary to comply with government-required mandates such as CMMC. The General Manager will identify untapped market areas and build plans to capture those opportunities.

Successful outcomes

• Operate as a true GM leading sales, services, support that aligns parent-company dependencies into a single, accountable operating rhythm

• Optimize post-sales execution by driving consistent deployments, adoption, and renewal readiness across Public Sector accounts

• Manage overall expense to revenue targets

• Spend the company’s money wisely to invest in new opportunities

• Work closely with the parent to drive the overall Public Sector product roadmap and align any support needed from the shared services teams

• Maintain positive evaluations from relevant government agencies such as DCSA

Characteristics

• Demonstrated ability to manage directly and delegate effectively across all areas of responsibilities

• Create a culture of trust and accountability within Collibra Public Sector

• Know when to build consensus and when to maintain autonomy

• Bold risk-taking based on deep understanding of complex data

• Politically astute when dealing with diverse stakeholders and conflicting demands

Experience

• Experience managing a complete public sector subsidiary within a larger organization

• Extended positions with increasing levels of responsibilities within enterprise software companies

• Successful execution of business transformations and realignments

• Bachelor’s degree required, MBA preferred

Benefits at Collibra

Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits (https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/benefits).

We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion (https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/dei) at Collibra.

At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.

With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category. If you have a need that requires accommodation, let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form (https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/accommodations).

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/collibra-general-manager-collibra-public-sector
